done_when: Close's review and plan reads do not wait for an agent place, and a test run limited to a few named test files does not wait for the test place

findings.body: Raise: Functional — A standalone `fast_test = "forge test --pytest {base}"` can bypass the test place even when the run includes a full second suite. New evidence beyond the earlier compound-command finding is the picker’s underlying `test` command: with `test = "pytest tests && npm test"` and an npm `node --test` script, `few_tests` counts only the selected Python files here. `fasttest.py:300-305,332` keeps the Node command, while `fasttest.py:57-86` narrows only pytest. Five selected Python files therefore admit an unrestricted full Node run outside the machine’s test limit. The named lane proof covers a compound `fast_test`, but not this standalone-picker case.
findings.title: Standalone picker runs a full second suite without a test place

why: A 2-minute review waits about 10 minutes for an agent place and a worker's small test run queues for the single test place
